name: Dumbbell Sumo Pull-Through
steps: Stand in a wide sumo stance with your toes turned slightly outward, holding one dumbbell with both hands hanging between your legs.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and hinge back at your hips with a flat back, guiding the dumbbell back between your thighs.
Press your feet into the floor and extend your hips and knees to stand tall.
Finish with the dumbbell hanging between your thighs, then send your hips back again.
tips: Treat your arms like ropes and power the lift entirely with your hips rather than pulling with your arms.
Keep your spine neutral and avoid overarching your lower back at lockout.
